B:
kaṇṇaroga： kaṇṇaroga（pu）

[ကဏ္ဏ+ရောဂ]
K:
kaṇṇaroga：ကဏ္ဏရောဂ （ပု）
[ကဏ္ဏ+ရောဂ]
နား၏（ပြင်ပ၌ဖြစ်သော）-အနာ-ရောဂါ၊ နားရောဂါ။

CPD: kaṇṇa-roga , m., a disease of the ( outer ) ear; — exeg.: ~o ti bahikaṇṇe rogo, Mp V 43, 1 ( ad A V 110, 3 ); — cakkhurogo sotarogo ... ~o mukharogo +, Nidd l 13, 3 = 17, 18 = 361, 4 = A V 110, 3 ; Nidd l 47, 2 ; 252, 26 ; roga- phassena phuṭṭho ... assa, sotarogena ... ~ena, salla- rogena, 370, 4 ; 407, 23 = 465, 19 ; ll 166, 33 ; — ° âdi- ābādha , m., a disease such as disease of the ear; yo pi ~o so visamapaccayasamuṭṭhitadhātumattam eva, As 340, 13 .
